profile.summary:
•  23 years of experience in IT with expertise in various areas in 
	         -   MMIS (Medicaid Management Information System)
	         -  Steel Industry 
	         -   Auto Insurance 
	         -   Telecom billing
                 -   Mortgage loan Servicing 
•  Proven experience in technologies in 
    - Mainframe(COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS,PLI, MQ Series).
    - EDI (BizManager,Bizlink Mapper(INOVIS-GXS-OPENTEXT)) 
•  Good exposure in Agile, SDLC and aware of the processes needed to be followed in a CMM level 5 company.
•  Trustworthy, ethical, and discreet, committed to client satisfaction. Resourceful & committed in
completing the tasks within the time frame.

positions.title: Software Developer/ Programming Analyst - IOWA - Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS)
positions.description:

*************
I worked extensively in MMIS (Medicaid Management Information System) for2+ years in the areas of policy eligibility, retro months, MHC/DMHC assignments and SSI processing. I also work with the CMS data processing (TMSIS - Transformed Medicaid Statistical Information System) in identifying the data gaps and fixed many complicated issues. I also worked with the EDI processing with the MCO (Managed care organizations) for the enrolments and  dis-enrollments.

positions.title: Advisory System Analyst/Project Lead
positions.description:
AK Steel 
**********
I joined IBM India on 18th Oct 2010 as a Project Lead (Advisory System Analyst) in Mainframe Technologies. Currently in US from 15th Jan 2014 , working for AK Steel one of the world leader in Steel Industry. I joined the AKSteel Project for the EDI application and currently working on various new EDI implementations and migrations from the mainframe system. I am also responsible in fixing the production issues during the bridging of two independent applications in the Shop floor area. The main EDI tools used are Bizlink/GXS-OPENTEXT (AIX server) and Trading Partner (in the Mainframe System). During this time, I got chances to work with Mainframe transformations, Migration of all 810 transactions from Trading Partner to Bizlink, enhanced and implemented many 856 and 863 Transactions, and work with 850/560 and 830 Inbound Transactions. Also I looked into the EDI failures and tracks back the root cause of the issues.Supports the applications outside the normal Business Hours. While in India I was the project lead for the offshore team and maintained the EDI Application from Offshore. I was also involved in the PMR (Project Management Review) audits for the Project and got an “A” rating.

positions.title: System Analyst (Team Lead)
positions.description:
Telenor Fixed lines Billing allocations and OMS Batch ( 2 years and 9 Months)
********************************************************************
I worked (2 years and 9 months) in the telecom domain with Telenor (Norway) especially in the deFakto (fixed lines billing and the message Processing System) and various interfaces which use DB2, JCL, COBOL and MQ series. Deputed to Bergen (Norway) for three weeks to get the Knowledge transfer for OMS for all the incoming and outgoing interfaces to and from various other related Systems like account receivable (Saturn), Order Management System , Mobile management System etc using Message Queue (MQ).

Royal Sun Alliance AIS system (10 months)
**************************************************
I worked for 10 months in the Royal Sun Alliance (RSA UK) with the AIS (Accenture Insurance System) product for the Policy administration. I was mainly looking after live services area especially in Batch Support, Incident management, Performance Analysis, and Interfaces / Architecture Areas. AIS (Accenture Insurance System) is an Accenture owned product for the insurance solutions especially in the Policy Administration.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Mortgage Services (Mserv)for HSBC.
******************************************
The four years, has enabled to comprehend to an extent, the functionality of the Mortgage Serv System, which is the Servicing part for the Mortgage Loans in HSBC Mortgage Services. The project worked with has helped to gain a better working and functional knowledge in this, a product of FISERV. Worked for the BIS (Bulk information system) System for 3 months, which is a subsidiary of Mortgage services where the document and the affidavit details are stored. Handled the Batch Cycle Support for the Entire Mortgage Serv System in HSBC for more than 3 years.Gained lot of experience in mainframe technologies MVS,JCL, VSAM, DB2 etc.
